_comment: Cards that exist only for tests/unit/targets/test_single_graveyard.py. Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_single_grave_sweep` is Waste Management's unkicked half: up to two target cards, every one from the same graveyard. `t_any_grave_sweep` is the near miss without the rule, and `t_single_grave_pair` the exact-count spelling (Pestilent Cauldron's "four target cards from a single graveyard", at two).

cards.name: Test Single Grave Sweep
cards.oracle_text: Exile up to two target cards from a single graveyard.

cards.name: Test Any Grave Sweep
cards.oracle_text: Exile up to two target cards from graveyards.

cards.name: Test Single Grave Pair
cards.oracle_text: Exile two target cards from a single graveyard.
